name: Reyansh
physical_description: 10-year-old South Asian boy, hair swept to one side, navy track jacket with white piping, a purple hearing aid behind the left ear that he wears or doesn't depending on the day, signs with quick precise hands
strengths: reads faces and hands faster than anyone reads words
notices what people do instead of what they say
vulnerabilities: people talk about him as if he is not there
hearing kids pretend to sign and think it is funny
fear_carried_in: that being left out of the conversation means being left out of the plan
story_premise: someone at the school assembly is not who they say they are, and the only kid who was watching faces instead of listening to the speech is the only one who noticed
totem: a folded paper fortune-teller he keeps in his pocket
